opening.argument: The title directly invites viewers to join Forsage and presents that invitation through a claimed leader affiliation, identifying “VIRENDRA KUMAR SIR” and associating the program with an MLM plan and leaders. The speaker further connects working with an organization or business to having “more chances to gain a lot of profit,” promoting substantial profit from participation without detailing the wording beyond that business context. The invitation is explicit: viewers are told to understand the material and “join business.” Although the video also explains blockchain technology and its types, that technical discussion does not remove the separate solicitation to participate in the described business.
